description: Plan S33: library chunks and memory entries for plain-chat RAG, @library and memory retrieval. Synthetic documents under eval/fixtures/library_memory/docs/ and synthetic memories below; every name, company, product and figure is invented. Labels were written from the chunk and memory text before any scoring (D3 safeguards). A library label names a phrase that must occur in exactly one chunk of its document; every chunk or memory without a label is irrelevant.

Session summary: we reviewed the Harbour Street lease, focusing on the break clause (earliest exit 31 August 2026) and whether the cat needs a pet deposit (it does not, but the carpets must be professionally cleaned at check-out).
Session summary: we planned the Lisbon itinerary, moved the Sintra day trip to Saturday and booked the fado evening for Monday.
Session summary: we worked through singular value decomposition practice questions and the Eckart–Young theorem for the exam.
Session summary: we diagnosed a dense sourdough crumb with big holes at the top; the conclusion was underproofing, so the next bake gets a longer bulk ferment.
Session summary: we drafted the Ledger API pagination and idempotency text and decided on cursor pagination with 24-hour idempotency keys.
